Title: Azure API for FHIR and Our Growing Ecosystem of Partners

Body.Content:
Azure API for FHIR has been released in generally availability to all Azure customers. What’s more compelling are the solutions that you will build with the service.

For any end-to-end solution built around Azure API for FHIR, below is a representation of how data would flow from “systems of record” to “systems of engagement”.

And when building such a solution, you may require the help of a partner for their unique IP in a specific area or for help stitching everything together. There are a growing number of such partners and a few of them have been curated in this list for you. Check back periodically as this ecosystem will continue to grow.

Learn more
